title: Godot editor crash after add the `discard` keyword into a `light` function on a 2D shader
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.5 stable, 4.6 stable, 4.7 stable, 4.8 dev 2 and latest master (fb1821384) ### System information Godot v4.8.dev (fb1821384) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.8864) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Adding the `discard` keyword inside a 2D shader attached to a visible node crashes Godot. Only happens with `Vulkan` as driver on both `Forward+` and `Mobile` renderers.
Some errors are throw before the crash happens: ``` SPIR-V Parsing error. Result 663 is not valid. SPIR-V Parsing error. Result 666 is not valid. SPIR-V Parsing error. Result 666 is not valid. SPIR-V Parsing error. Result 1090 is not valid. SPIR-V Parsing error. Result 874 is not valid. SPIR-V Parsing error. Result 663 is not valid. ```
